title: Single-page portfolio for Harsh Bulchandani (static, minimal modern)

requirements.summary: Create a single-page portfolio header with the uploaded profile photo centered at the very top from a static frontend asset.
acceptanceCriteria: The profile photo is shown at the top of the page in a header section and is visually centered.
The profile photo loads from a static asset included in the frontend build (no backend fetch required).
The profile photo includes English alt text (e.g., "Profile photo of Harsh Bulchandani").

file_operations.description: Add the uploaded image as a public static asset to be referenced directly by the portfolio header (do not modify the image file contents).

Implement the single-page portfolio layout with a top header section that centers an referencing the static asset at frontend/public/assets/IMG_20251225_164253.jpg and uses alt text "Profile photo of Harsh Bulchandani".

requirements.summary: Apply CSS-only blur-behind and subtle brightness filter styling to the profile photo area without altering the image file.
acceptanceCriteria: The blur effect is applied to the background behind the photo container (not destructively to the image file).
A subtle brightness/lighting increase is applied using CSS filters, without obvious color shifting.
No image editing pipeline is introduced; the original uploaded image remains unchanged on disk.

file_operations.description: Add global styles (Tailwind base/components/utilities plus custom classes) to support a header photo container with a soft background blur behind it (e.g., via a pseudo-element/backdrop-filter) and apply a subtle CSS filter brightness increase on the image element itself—CSS only, with natural colors.
Wire the photo area to use the CSS classes that implement the blur-behind effect and slight brightness increase, ensuring the blur is behind the container and not applied destructively to the image.

requirements.summary: Render all required portfolio content sections beneath the header in the specified order with exact provided English text and list formatting.
acceptanceCriteria: All specified sections appear on a single page beneath the header.
Section text matches the user-provided wording and punctuation (including the • separators in the tagline).
Services and Why Choose Me are presented as clear lists (bulleted or card/list format).

file_operations.description: Add the static content sections under the header in the exact required order and with the exact text: Name (Harsh Bulchandani), Tagline (Creative Editing • Content Writing • Graphic Design), About Me paragraph, Services I Offer (3 items), Why Choose Me (4 bullet points), Tools Used (Canva, MS Word, Google Docs), and Design Style description; format Services and Why Choose Me as clear lists.

requirements.summary: Implement minimal, modern, trustworthy styling with soft pastel backgrounds, clean sans-serif typography, generous whitespace, and a mobile-friendly single-column layout.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile widths, content is readable and presented as a single column with comfortable spacing.
Typography is consistent and uses a clean sans-serif look across headings/body.
Background and component styling use soft, non-saturated pastel tones and ample whitespace.
No blue/purple-dominant theme is introduced unless required by the provided content (keep it neutral, soft, and professional).

file_operations.description: Define the global design system styling (soft neutral/pastel page background, consistent sans-serif typography defaults, spacing scale helpers, and readable heading/body styles) while keeping the theme neutral and professional (avoid blue/purple-dominant palettes).

Apply a single-column responsive layout (container widths, padding, and vertical rhythm) using Tailwind utility classes and/or the custom styles from frontend/src/index.css to ensure mobile-friendly readability and generous whitespace.
